name: Yusasa
bio: Yusasa is a cheerful soul known best for her boundless curiosity and love of nature. Both, she learned from her homeland: a Shred of flying islands connected by giant bamboo forests. Now those forests are plagued with blight, and Yusasa seeks the cure in Pelanna, among the cultists of the Black Sun.
